rationale: Design taken from the methods section of Pinto-Fernandez et al., Br J Cancer 124:817-830 (2021), doi:10.1038/s41416-020-01167-y. Methods state HAP1 (CML-derived) wild-type and HAP1 USP18-/- CRISPR knockout cells, treated with human IFN-alpha2b at 1000 U/mL, with the GlyGly peptidome comparison performed at 48 h. GlyGly peptides were enriched by immunoaffinity purification using the PTMScan Ubiquitin Remnant Motif kit and analysed on a Q Exactive HF; searches were run in MaxQuant v1.5.5.1 against UniProtKB human with LFQ quantitation. Column names in the site table encode genotype (WT / KO), treatment (presence or absence of the _IFN token) and replicate index (1-3) unambiguously, so the mapping from column to condition is direct. One column, 'KO_1_181212063719', carries a trailing instrument run identifier which was stripped to recover the sample name; this is a naming inconsistency in the deposit, not a distinct condition. No SDRF-Proteomics file accompanies the deposit, which is expected for a 2020 submission, so this mapping is an inference from the publication rather than an authoritative statement from the submitters — hence confidence 'inferred' rather than 'authoritative'. Quantitative values used are the 'Ratio mod/base' columns, which divide modified-peptide intensity by the unmodified protein signal and therefore measure stoichiometry natively; the raw 'Intensity' columns are confounded by interferon-driven induction of the parent proteins and should not be used for this contrast.
unresolved: Timepoint for the unstimulated (non-IFN) arms is not stated separately in the methods; timepoint_h is therefore recorded only for the IFN arms and left absent elsewhere rather than assumed to be 48 h.

Replicate type (biological vs technical) is not explicitly stated in the methods for the GlyGly peptidome. Recorded as 'unspecified' pending author correspondence. This affects how the variance estimate in any differential test should be interpreted.
Whether a matched wild-type-only site table exists as a separate file in the deposit, or whether this single table contains all twelve samples. The column names indicate the latter.

project.title and experiment.title resolved 2026-08-07: supplied as 'USP18-dependent ISGylation' and 'HAP1 USP18 knockout diGly proteomics, ±IFN-α2b'. The reasoning that made them blocking still holds and is why the loader refused for a day rather than proceeding: both are identifying (ONTOLOGY.md §3), so no Experiment id and therefore no Sample id could be constructed until the curator provided them, and the loader must refuse rather than derive a title from the accession — inventing one is forbidden (CLAUDE.md: real external identifiers only). See corrections for the scoping the curator chose and what it deliberately excludes.

experiment.organism_taxid is stated at experiment level rather than derived from the mapping, because it is identifying on Experiment (ONTOLOGY.md §3). Consequence: one organism per Experiment, so cross-species work is two Experiments, not one with mixed samples.

source_type resolved 2026-08-07: 'cell_line' on all twelve entries — HAP1 is a near-haploid human cell line derived from KBM-7. model_system stays absent; that absence is determined by source_type (ONTOLOGY.md §3).

The `pending` block is absent as of 2026-08-07 because nothing is pending; it is not a required key. While present, its dotted paths are machine-detectable so the loader refuses by name rather than failing late on a null, and `unresolved` carries the reasoning a marker cannot. Marker for detection, prose for reasoning — the mechanism stands for the next record.

corrections.supersedes: the quantity preference stated in `rationale`, which is retained above unedited
corrections.note: The rationale prefers the 'Ratio mod/base' columns and states the raw 'Intensity' columns should not be used for this contrast. Measurement contradicts that preference. Ratio mod/base yields only 23 testable sites of 2,056 — stoichiometrically correct but unusable at this modification's occupancy — while Intensity with Perseus-style imputation yields thousands and recovers 12 of the 14 published targets (ROADMAP.md, Measured findings, 2026-08-06). The analysis actually run is recorded in analysis_PXD018299_KOIFN_vs_WTIFN.json with quantity 'intensity_multiplicity_summed'. The reasoning behind the original preference was sound — Intensity IS confounded by interferon-driven induction of the parent proteins — and that confound is now carried as protein_adjusted='not_applied', labelled stoichiometry-uncorrected wherever the result appears (I4), rather than by discarding the quantity. The mapping keys below still name the Ratio columns and are left untouched: they record which columns this curation was written against.

corrections.supersedes: the reasoning in the `unresolved` entry on timepoint_h, which is retained above unedited
corrections.note: That entry reads the absent timepoint on the unstimulated arms as a value that exists and was not reported ("not stated separately in the methods ... rather than assumed to be 48 h"). The column had no DDL comment at the time, so what it measures was unstated and "unknown" could not be told from "inapplicable" — the curator's caution was correct given that. ONTOLOGY.md §5 now defines timepoint_h as hours SINCE TREATMENT, and §3 classifies its absence as determined by `treatment`. Under that definition an arm with treatment 'none' has no elapsed-since-treatment, so the null is the right value and not a gap: the six unstimulated samples are keyable as they stand. Nothing in this record changed and no timepoint was assumed; the 48 h on the IFN arms is still the methods' "comparison performed at 48 h", measured from treatment. The deposit carries no time information at all — its sample names encode genotype x IFN x replicate only — so it neither supports nor contradicts this reading.

corrections.supersedes: the `unresolved` entry stating that project.title and experiment.title are not supplied, annotated in place per the convention entry 5 of that list already set
corrections.note: Both titles were supplied by the curator on 2026-08-07 and both `pending` markers removed, so the record loads: 16 nodes (1 Project, 1 Experiment, 1 Dataset, 1 curation Analysis, 12 Sample) and 38 edges, accepted by invariants.validate. The scoping, recorded because it governs every record after this one. PROJECT is the research question — not the laboratory, the platform or the deposit — so a second unrelated line of work is a second Project node. It is broad enough that the higher-coverage USP18 dataset expected in September sits under it as a new Experiment, and specific enough not to be reused by accident, `title` being Project's only identifying field and deliberate reuse its one collision case. EXPERIMENT carries every discriminator that will matter once a second exists: cell background, genetic perturbation, modality, treatment axis. Deliberately excluded from it: the accession, because PXD018299 identifies the Dataset and the September data will be a different deposit of arguably the same experiment; and any year, because Experiment has no temporal identity and dating it would make a re-run of one design look like two. Not annotated: the timepoint entry at the head of `unresolved`, which the 2026-08-07 correction above governs and states is retained unedited — every clause of it is still factually true, and editing it to add a status would make that correction's own claim false.
